title: QUIC RFC 9000 S9P6P1 Preferred Address Validation Failure Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused S9P6P1-0005 requirement-home tests over preferred-address validation failure, followed by the preferred-address regression ring, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the generated non-clean S9P6P1 preferred-address validation-failure tail for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P6P1-0005.
expected_result: The focused tests show the failed preferred-address candidate is abandoned without promotion, the preferred path is not recorded as recently validated, future sends continue on the original server address after IPv4 preferred-address validation failure, and the same behavior holds for an IPv6 original/preferred-address edge.
procedure: Run the focused S9P6P1-0005 requirement-home filter.
Run the focused S9P6P1 preferred-address regression ring.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The S9P6P1 preferred-address handshake-confirmed transition remains closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0080.
The base runtime path-validation model remains owned by ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0001.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim complete S9P6P1 closure, server preferred_address emission proof, per-family preferred-address metadata cleanup, public migration APIs, multipath support, hosted interop readiness, or closure of deferred fuzz obligations.

status_summary: Local verification on 2026-05-06 passed: focused S9P6P1-0005 requirement-home filter 3/3; focused preferred-address regression ring 12/12; Release build 0 warnings/errors; regenerated QUIC coverage triage 1,313/1,771 trace-clean; SpecTrace core validation 487 artifacts; full Release no-build suite 4,577/4,577. git diff --check is recorded in the final closure report.
